turnos.t: How do I scan everything happening outside a business?
With STEEPLE: social, technological, economic and environmental factors, plus political, legal and ethical ones. Its results feed the opportunities and threats in your SWOT.
Do I need all seven every time?

No. Pick only the ones that really matter to the case. For an e-bike shop in Barcelona: legal, the low-emission zone restricts older cars, so more people buy e-bikes. Economic, higher interest rates make a loan for a second shop more expensive.
